## ⚙️ Configuration Required

⚠️ This n8n instance runs with `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE`, so `$env.*` **cannot** be used inside nodes (it fails with "access to env vars denied"). Set these values **directly** on the 5 HTTP Request nodes — Get Available Slots, Book Appointment, Cancel Appointment, Create Patient, Get Available Providers:

| Placeholder | Replace with |
|---|---|
| `https://YOUR-API-BASE-URL` (node URL) | Fastify API base URL, publicly reachable from n8n (e.g. the ngrok https URL) |
| `Bearer YOUR_FASTIFY_API_KEY` (Authorization header) | `Bearer <key>` matching the API's `process.env.FASTIFY_API_KEY` |

**ngrok note:** start it as `ngrok http 127.0.0.1:3000` (NOT `localhost`, which resolves to IPv6 `::1` on Windows where the API doesn't listen → 502). The ngrok URL changes on every restart, so re-apply it to all 5 nodes each time.

---

### What changed from v1:
- ❌ Google Calendar removed → ✅ `GET /api/calendar/slots`
- ❌ Google Sheets (Appointments) removed → ✅ `POST /api/appointments`
- ❌ Google Sheets (Patient Info) removed → ✅ `POST /api/patients`
- ❌ Calculate Available Slots Code node removed → ✅ Handled server-side in Fastify
- ✅ `provider_name` parameter supported in check_availability & book_appointment (availability comes from CalendarEvent rows in the DB)
